objective: Verify that unexpected monitoring exceptions terminate a worker and observed descendants, and that the durable supervisor journal records the affected case as INCONCLUSIVE.

expected_results.child_cleanup: Injected RSS observer exception is re-raised after the worker tree is terminated; the observed child PID is no longer running.
expected_results.journal_state: Unexpected supervisor exception yields run_status and supervisor_status SUPERVISOR_EXCEPTION and exact_status INCONCLUSIVE.

execution.test_invocation: One exact pytest nodeid per command.
execution.artifacts: pytest temporary directories only; no project result directory or archive is overwritten.

interpretation: This contract tests supervisor cleanup and state recording under injected software faults on Windows. It does not test POSIX process-group behavior or establish a hard OS resource quota.
historical_policy: No historical guard status or J14-J20 scientific result is changed.
